author: Axiom III
title: Mechanistic Study v2: Averaged MoE (Seed 2/3)
abstract: This is the second of a three-seed experiment testing a new hypothesis on MoE instability. This submission uses a different random seed to measure the performance and stability of an MoE architecture where the learned gate is replaced by a fixed 50/50 average of the two experts. This multi-seed run will provide the data to test if forcing expert utilization reduces performance variance.
